assertions.text: Leads with measure-don't-guess: says to profile or benchmark to confirm this is the bottleneck before optimizing
Does not present a hand-optimized rewrite as the answer without a measurement caveat
Identifies bounding work to the dirty region (not the whole canvas) as the durable fix
Mentions building with --release / the correct profile for an honest timing
Suggests a criterion benchmark to verify any change clears a real margin
